body:
This cleans-up the way the usage line is produce in the help by stripping all spurious trailing spaces produced by various parameters and indention setup. Also normalizes the second whitespace-only line that is used as separator for that section of the help screen.

Closes #3360.

The other related bug https://github.com/pallets/click/issues/1550 I mentioned in https://github.com/pallets/click/issues/3360#issuecomment-4287259287 has been fixed in an unrelated commit a while ago. But use the opportunity to cover that case in the new test suite.
title: Fix `HelpFormatter.write_usage` producing spurious characters
